rule_catalog.R1_COMPLETE_EVENT: An event is a complete typed structure: minimal contiguous trigger, typed arguments, required nesting, and event-local modifiers.
rule_catalog.R2_CLOSED_TYPES: Use only the published Cancer Genetics source event types and preserve their exact type.
rule_catalog.R3_DIRECTION: Positive_regulation and Negative_regulation require explicit direction; otherwise use Regulation.
rule_catalog.R4_ROLES: Theme undergoes the primary effect; Cause is causally active; Participant is involved without a more specific supported role; Instrument carries out a Planned_process.
rule_catalog.R5_NESTING: When an affected or causing object is itself an event, preserve the event-to-event argument and do not flatten it into an entity.
rule_catalog.R6_ARGUMENT_MINIMALITY: Do not add an argument merely because an entity appears in the same sentence.
rule_catalog.R7_MODIFIER_SCOPE: NEGATED or SPECULATIVE applies only when wording modifies that exact event.
rule_catalog.R8_ALL_AXES: ENTAILED requires event type, trigger, participants, roles, nesting, modifier, and evidence all to pass.
rule_catalog.R9_GOLD_FIDELITY: Benchmark credit requires equality with a complete public-gold event, not general source plausibility.
